docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Matthew Henson's own account of Peary's expedition of 1908–1909, on which he reached the North Pole.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Matthew Henson (1866–1955), A Negro Explorer at the North Pole, 1912, with a foreword by Robert E. Peary (1856–1920) and an introduction by Booker T. Washington (1856–1915). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
